Privacy Policy

Last updated: July 31, 2026

Welcome to ClaudeNovo (hereinafter referred to as "the Service"), a free browser-based vector design editor available at www.claudenovo.com. We take your privacy seriously and are committed to protecting your information. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect information when you use ClaudeNovo.

1. Information Collection

We may collect the following types of information:

  • Usage Analytics: We use Google Analytics to collect aggregated, anonymous information such as page views, approximate location (country/region), device type, browser type, and general interaction patterns. This helps us understand how the Service is used and improve it.
  • Local Project Data: Your design projects, settings, and preferences are stored locally in your browser (for example via localStorage or IndexedDB). This data stays on your device unless you choose to export or share it.
  • Technical Logs: When processing runs in the browser (such as AI background removal), computation happens on your device. We do not receive your design files or uploaded images on our servers for editing features.

2. Use of Information

The information we collect is used for the following purposes:

  • To provide, maintain, and improve ClaudeNovo
  • To understand usage patterns and optimize performance and user experience
  • To detect, prevent, and address technical issues

3. Third-Party Services

The Service may use third-party services that process limited technical data:

  • Google Analytics: Collects aggregated usage statistics after you accept cookies in our consent dialog. See Google's Privacy Policy.
  • Fonts / CDN providers: Loading web fonts may involve requests to third-party servers (for example Google Fonts).

Using ClaudeNovo requires accepting cookies via the consent dialog. Your acceptance is stored in your browser (local storage) so we do not ask again on every visit. ClaudeNovo does not use advertising networks or sell personal information.

4. Data Storage and Security

Your design projects are primarily stored on your device. Analytics data is processed by Google Analytics according to their policies. We take reasonable measures appropriate for a static web application hosted on GitHub Pages.

5. Children's Privacy

The Service is not directed at children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child under 13 has provided us with personal information, please contact us and we will take appropriate steps.

6. Your Rights

Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or restrict processing of personal information. Because most project data is stored locally on your device, you can clear it by clearing your browser storage for this site. For analytics-related requests or questions, contact us using the information below.

7. Privacy Policy Updates

We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Updated policies will be posted on this page with a new update date. We recommend reviewing this policy periodically.

8. Contact Us

If you have any questions or suggestions about this privacy policy, please contact us at:
